overview_description.description: Zone is a decentralized GameFi and esports platform designed to bring blockchain technology into mainstream gaming experiences. Built across multiple blockchain networks including Algorand and BNB Chain, the platform offers a wide variety of gaming experiences such as hypercasual games, fantasy sports, PvP competitions, esports tournaments, and reward-based gaming challenges. The platform focuses on player engagement through competitive gameplay, digital rewards, NFT integrations, and crypto-enabled marketplaces. Zone has hosted large-scale Web3 gaming tournaments and fan engagement campaigns, attracting hundreds of thousands of gamers globally. Its ecosystem also includes crypto gift card marketplaces, gaming leagues, and sports-focused activations that bridge traditional entertainment with blockchain-based incentives.
